sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/OFFBEAT/2026 Offbeat Collection Wholesale Rates (30%) AMENDED.pdf
notes: Part of the same 8-property Offbeat document - see offbeat-mara-camp-2026.json for sibling properties.
Minimum charge for exclusive use of camp is 10 adults at the applicable season's rate.
Wholesale rate confirmed arithmetically as Rack x 0.70 (e.g. Low adult: $389 = $555 x 0.70).
specials: Early Bird Discount: 5% off accommodation, deposit 9 months prior. All seasons, combinable with 2 & 3.
Family Discount: 3rd child sharing a triple pays conservation fees only.
Per Single rate only from 2nd single room per booking.
Honeymooners Discount: 25% off accommodation for one of the couple.
4 nights for price of 3 (Regular & Low seasons).
6 nights for price of 5 when booking Ekorian for 3 nights (Low/Regular) + Offbeat Mara or Offbeat Ndoto for 3 nights (Regular/Mid/Green).
includes: Exclusive use of vehicle for 4+ pax
excludes: Transfers from Loisaba airstrip: $120/car each way
Vintage wines and champagne on request
Late departure after 2pm: $100pp (incl. lunch and game drive)
Exclusive use of vehicle (less than 4 pax): $250/vehicle/day
Pokot or Samburu boma visit: $150/car (6 pax)
Ride on horseback with mounted rangers (anti-poaching patrol) - pre-booking required, rates on request

policies.deposit: 20% deposit confirms booking; balance due 45 days prior to arrival.
policies.cancellation: >120 days: 20% deposit refunded (net of bank charges); 120-46 days: 20% deposit forfeited; 45-30 days: 50% of full booking value forfeited; <30 days or no-show: 100% forfeited.
